title: Cobblemon: Clear View
description: Clears the foliage in a customizeable radius around your Cobblemon battle!
body:
An addon for Cobblemon that hides obscuring foliage during battles and restores it afterward.

In vanilla Cobblemon, battles start wherever you happen to be standing; which is often in tall grass, a flower patch, or dense undergrowth. The player camera doesn't account for this, so any foliage between you and the Pokémon ends blocking your view of the encounter. Clear View removes that foliage for the duration of the battle and puts every block back when the battle ends.

Features
Automatic foliage removal at battle start. When a Cobblemon battle begins, the mod scans the area around the battle and replaces short grass, ferns, flowers, and other intangible plant blocks with air. You can see your Pokémon and the opposing Pokémon clearly for the entire encounter, without standing up to clear the area first or breaking blocks you'd rather keep.
Full per-block restoration at battle end. Every block the mod removes is recorded with its exact block state. When the battle ends (by victory, defeat, capture, or running) each block is placed back in its original position.
Works for wild encounters and trainer battles. The mod treats both battle types the same way, so the view-clearing behavior is consistent no matter what kind of fight you're in.
Only affects replaceable foliage. Solid blocks, terrain, crops, and player-placed builds are never touched, so your battle arenas, your farms, and your decorative builds are untouched. 

Open config menu (default: Y) to select either 3, 6, 9, and 18 block radius, centered between pokemon, (default is 18); Pokemon only mode which clears a two block radius sphere centered on each pokemon; or Trimmed, which replaces all grass in an 18-block radius with Trimmed Grass, and leaves flowers and crops alone, great for naturalized arenas like grass or bug type gyms!

Requires: NeoForge, Cobblemon

Uninstalling: Restoration data is tracked in memory for the duration of each battle. If the mod is removed mid-battle, or if the server crashes during a battle, the temporarily-cleared blocks will remain as air and will not restore on their own. To uninstall safely, ensure no battles are active first, then remove the mod between battles.

Feel free to use in any modpack!
